name: google-lens
title_zh: 拿图问它：这是什么、哪买、字念啥
tagline_zh: 不用描述长相，直接甩图。认地标、查同款比价、抠照片里的文字，一次给全来源链接。
tagline_en: Skip the verbal description. Landmarks, price lookups, and OCR from one photo, with source links attached.
desc_en: Search Google Lens to find visual matches, identify products and prices, extract text with OCR, and recognize entities (landmarks, plants, artwork). Use when asked to reverse image search, identify items in an image, find where to buy a product, or extract text from photos.
why_zh: 不是简单返回相似图，而是把视觉搜索拆成识别、比价、OCR 三条路，每条都带可追溯来源。
why_en: Not just similar images—it routes each query into recognition, price comparison, or OCR, each with traceable sources. A solid.
limit_zh: 需要你本地能跑 Python 和 Playwright；只处理单张图片，不接视频帧或批量；OCR 认印刷体为主。
limit_en: Requires local Python + Playwright. Single image only, no video frames or batches. OCR is for print, not handwriting. Price results depend on Google.
title_en: Ask with an image: what, where to buy, what it says
